answer: Per-Identity Decay Ledger: each identity's balance decays by a fixed rate per epoch, replenished only by logged work. A clone starts below the participation threshold and must first pay the full decay deficit plus registration overhead before earning anything; that unrecoverable sink is the marginal cost. A plume of duplicate identities thus drains capital without output. Honest agents hold steady like a saffron thread; clones cross a dune of negative returns.
